verdict.rationale: Remote's CLI documents bulk export: every list command can export a whole list of items to CSV, and the sync guide describes loading the full workforce list at once. That covers bulk read/export across many items. No batch write, update or approve operation is documented; the CLI and MCP evidence shows per-item actions only. Missing for 10: documented batch create/update/approve endpoints or commands, bulk action semantics (limits, partial-failure handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Every list command exports to CSV with `-o csv`, and every command can emit JSON, so the output drops straight into spreadsheets and scripts.
export any list straight to a spreadsheet
load the full list once, then let webhooks push you the changes.
